merged: **Domaine des Trois Chênes – Handover Summary (≤150 words)** - Estate: 18 ha (11 ha Cabernet Franc, 7 ha Chenin Blanc) on clay‑flint soils. - Production: ~62 000 bottles / yr; 2024 output 48 000 after May hail damaged the western plots (reports vary – ≈ 20 % loss, possibly a fifth). - Certification: Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion started 2023, earliest certification 2026. - Exports: 41 % of volume to Belgium and Japan; Japan limits sulphites to < 60 mg/L. - Past issues: 2022 Tank 4 controller drift cost €11 000 – now calibrated pre‑harvest with a second probe; 2023 label error recalled 900 bottles (proofs now require two signatures). - Rules: No irrigation on western plots; harvest dates set after three mornings of sugar/acidity readings; tanks >28 °C must be cooled within four hours. - Open items (uncertain): lighter‑weight bottles – importer interest unconfirmed, no cost comparison; eastern
